description:
Hushfeed v0.82.0 has 147 patches for global TikTok 47.7.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

TikTok moves to 47.7.3, so grab that build from APKMirror and keep the same signing key. Update Morphe Manager to 2.5.0 first, because older ones won't load this bundle. New: a date jump and a search box on Liked grids, Fold long comments, Pause before the feed and an optional Hushfeed update check.

All 147 patches applied to the supported APK. This bundle ran through a whole-app walk of TikTok on a signed-in Galaxy S22 with no crash.

Needs Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer. Refresh the Hushfeed source to update. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.

### Features

* Hushfeed now supports TikTok 47.7.3, and only that one. 47.7.2 isn't supported anymore. Grab the 47.7.3 bundle or APK from APKMirror and patch it with the same signing key, so your login and settings carry over.
* Hushfeed builds on Morphe patcher 2.3.0 now, so it needs Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer, or morphe-desktop 2.1.1 on a computer. Older Managers refuse the bundle.
* `Jump to a date on Liked grids` puts a button in the Liked grid's top corner. Pick a year, then a month or the whole year, and your likes start there, so older ones load without scrolling through everything newer. Newest likes in the same menu goes back. It starts off and lives in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, under the grid sort rows (#350).
* `Show where commenters are from` also checks the country field on a commenter's account, and uses it only when it holds a two letter code (#201).
* `Long press on Profile opens my watch history` makes holding the Profile tab show the watch history kept on your phone, so the long press on For You can keep opening Hushfeed settings. A tap on Profile works as before. It starts off, sits under `Keep my own watch history` and needs the `Feed tab navigation` patch (#172).
* `Long-press Profile to switch accounts` brings back holding the Profile tab to pick another of your accounts, for accounts where TikTok left that hold out. A tap on Profile works as before, and while `Long-press Profile for Watch history` is on, that one gets the hold. It starts off, lives in Hushfeed settings > Feed tabs and takes a TikTok restart (#388).
* `Discover in the bottom bar` puts Discover where Friends sits in the bottom bar, the layout TikTok gives Indonesia, and your region and feed stay as they are. It starts off, lives in Hushfeed settings > Feed tabs and takes a TikTok restart (#98).
* `Friends in the top tabs` moves Friends up to the tabs along the top of the feed, just left of Following, and Discover takes its spot in the bottom bar, the layout TikTok gives Indonesia. Your region and feed stay as they are (#98).
* The Feature Gate Lab can override experiments TikTok reads as a whole object, like the home tab layout. It couldn't reach those before. An override changes only the fields you give it, and it still applies when TikTok sent your account nothing for that experiment (#98).
* The diagnostic report names the code other patch bundles added to your TikTok, or says there's none. A bundle built from the same template as Hushfeed, with the same package names, no longer counts as Hushfeed's own code. When the last crash happened inside one of them, it says which, even when TikTok's own code passed the error along. When a report runs long, `Copy quick report` now drops only the oldest events and keeps every other part whole, this one included. It also lists the last five times Android closed TikTok and why, where it used to show only the last one (#275).
* The diagnostic export has a Font section. It shows which font TikTok's text went out in, whether an imported font loaded (and if it didn't, why), and the Samsung font style on Galaxy phones (#346).
* Settings an update adds get a small dot after their name in Hushfeed settings, and the closed section they sit in gets one too, so you can spot what's new. A dot goes away after the visit that shows it, and a fresh install starts with none (#349).
* `Startup message` shows a message you write each time TikTok opens, with an optional title. Turn off `Close with Back or a tap outside` and only its OK button closes it. Its `Don't show again` button hides that message until you change its title or text, or install or update TikTok again. Rotating the phone or changing TikTok's theme keeps a message you haven't closed on screen, and doesn't bring back one you have. It starts off and lives in Hushfeed settings > App (#347).
* `Check for Hushfeed updates` tells you in TikTok when a newer Hushfeed is out. Once a day at most, when TikTok opens, it asks GitHub for the latest release, and a newer one gets a card listing the first few things it changes. Update opens Morphe Manager (or the release page if Manager isn't installed) and Dismiss hides the card for that release. The request carries your Hushfeed version and nothing else, and the switch starts off. Find it in Hushfeed settings > App, under the startup message rows (#377).
* With a color picked in `AMOLED dark theme`'s options, Profile, Inbox and TikTok's other full pages take that color too. Before, they stayed black. The light look and the video feed don't change (#348).
* `Block P2P video relay` also takes out the LIVE relay's two leftover libraries, about 1 MB more. The split APK bundle never had them, so nothing changes for those installs (#70).
* `Bend the video at the edges` makes the glass pill's rim bend the blurred video behind it the way the edge of real glass does, and it gives the colors there a small lift. It sits under `Blur the video behind the bar`, starts off and needs Android 13 or newer (#231).
* Three new switches under the ring switches, `Remove rings on the feed`, `Remove rings in comments` and `Remove rings on profiles`, pick where the story and LIVE rings come off. All three start on, so nothing changes until you turn one off (#351).
* `Accent color` has two new options, `Like color` and `Save color`. They paint the heart on a video you liked and the bookmark on one you saved, in the feed and in their tap animations, with a preset or a color code you type. They work in light, dark and AMOLED, and with or without a new accent. Both start on TikTok's own red and yellow, which changes nothing (#369).
* `Hide On this day` takes the On this day memory off the front of the Inbox's stories tray, and the stories after it move up into its place. It starts off and sits under `Hide stories tray` in Hushfeed settings > Inbox (#358).
* `Hide profile pictures in comments` takes the commenter's picture off every comment and reply. The name and the comment move over to the left, so there's no empty space where the picture was. It starts off, sits under `Hide the thumbs down on comments` in Hushfeed settings > Comments and takes a TikTok restart (#352).
* `Custom hold speed` under Playback takes any speed you type, like 1.8 or 2.3, for holding a video and for the pull-down lock under it. It takes the place of `Speed while you hold the video`, and leaving it empty keeps that row's pick (#357).
* `Check for already-saved videos` covers `Save the original sound` too. Save a sound you already have, even from a different video that uses it, and you get Open or Save again instead of a second copy (#356).
* `Phone model for effects` under `Report a newer phone to effects` lets you pick the phone the effects server hears about, since an effect turned down for one phone can open for another. Tap it for a list of recent Galaxy and Pixel phones, or pick `Type another model` at the bottom and enter any model yourself. Left alone it stays the Galaxy S24 Ultra (#176).
* `Keep clear screen in the next LIVE` carries clear screen from one LIVE room to the next one you swipe to, so the chat, gifts and buttons stay hidden until you turn clear screen off. It starts off and sits in Hushfeed settings > Playback, next to `Offer clear screen in every LIVE room` (#354).
* `LIVE feed countries` under Hushfeed settings > Region asks the LIVE feed for rooms from the countries you list, like BR, MX, taking turns page by page. TikTok doesn't say which country a room comes from, so this steers the feed instead of filtering it, and a room from somewhere else can still turn up. Nothing else in TikTok sees the change. It needs the `Region spoof` patch but none of its switches, and it starts empty (#355).
* The diagnostic export has a Captions line. For each For You video it says whether TikTok sent caption tracks, and when it sent none, the reason TikTok gave, like not authorized or language not supported. That way an account whose captions never show can tell whether TikTok sends any at all (#217).
* Two new switches in Hushfeed settings > Comments, `Hide the close button in comments` and `Hide the expand button in comments`, each take one button off the top of the comments, and the buttons beside it move over into its place. Back or a swipe down still closes comments. TikTok only shows the expand button to some accounts. Both start off (#371).
* `Hide the search button on the feed` also hides the magnifying glass TikTok puts over the shrunken video while comments are open (#371).
* `Invisible controls button` puts a small eye at the top left of the main feed. Tap it and the buttons, caption and tabs turn invisible but keep working where they are, which helps against burn-in on OLED screens. Tap the eye again and they're back. Your choice sticks across videos and restarts. The eye stays off other tabs, comments, Clear display and videos you open from a profile or search, and Pause brings everything back. `Keep the caption in sight` under it leaves the creator's name, the caption and the music line showing. Both start off and sit in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, under `Keep faded controls in Clear display` (#374).
* `Hide Send to new group` takes the gray Send to new group button off the share sheet when you've picked two or more people, so Send separately is the only button left. It starts off and sits under `Hide the Send to row` in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet (#375).
* `AMOLED dark theme` has a switch now. `AMOLED dark mode` in Hushfeed settings > App starts on, and turning it off brings back TikTok's own dark grays after a restart, so you can keep the patch in and still pick plain dark mode. The color you picked in the patch's options stays for when it's on. Pause Hushfeed turns it off too (#372).
* `Make sticker` in a video's share sheet opens TikTok's own sticker editor for that video, so you can trim it, add text and save it as an animated sticker, even on videos where TikTok doesn't show its Create sticker button. If the editor can't open, the video's cover becomes the sticker like before (#214).
* `Automatically record LIVEs you enter` starts recording a LIVE's stream the moment you walk into the room. Swipe on to the next LIVE and that one starts recording too, while the one you left finishes saving in the background. Tap Stop and it stays stopped until you leave and come back. Screen recordings still need your tap and Android's permission. It starts off and sits under `Record LIVEs you watch` in Hushfeed settings > Playback. Thanks to Hiiva for building it (#363).
* `Drag handle and jump buttons on grids` shows a handle at the edge of a long profile, Liked or sound grid while it moves, with Top, Back and End buttons beside it. Back returns to where you were before the last jump. It starts off and lives in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen (#378).
* `Bottom bar icons` in Hushfeed settings > Feed tabs picks one of the icon sets TikTok is testing for the bottom bar, or leaves it to TikTok, which is how it starts. It takes a TikTok restart (#285).
* With `Log diagnostics` on, the report keeps TikTok's answer to every LIVE like, so a like TikTok refused can be told from one that never left the phone (#380).
* The settings screen now comes in Thai. Thanks to @MangaThatsFine (#381).
* `Pin more chats` lets you pin more than 5 chats in the Inbox. TikTok's app stops you at 5 even though its website doesn't, and pins you make there already show up in the app. It starts off, sits under `Show inbox filters` in Hushfeed settings > Inbox and takes a TikTok restart (#385).
* `Hide voice comments` takes voice comments out of a comment thread, replies included, the way `Hide picture comments` does for pictures and stickers. Your own voice comments stay. It starts off and sits under `Hide picture comments` in Hushfeed settings > Comments.
* `Also filter it` follows up a tap on the Not interested button. A short list offers the video's creator, its sound and up to three of its hashtags, and the one you pick goes on the feed filter's own list, so those videos stay gone even after TikTok forgets the feedback. Undo on the banner takes it back off. Cancel just closes the list, and the feedback still goes to TikTok. The sound is offered only while `Hide videos with blocked sounds` is on. It starts off and sits under `Show the Not interested button` in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
* A hashtag on a word list now hides only that tag. `#cat` used to hide `#cats` and `#catholic` too, and now it leaves them alone, which is what you'd expect from a tag. Write `cat` without the # to catch every word that has it. Tags written together, like `#fyp#cat`, still count one by one. The Turkish dotted and dotless i and the Greek final sigma now match on word lists and blocked sound names however they're typed, and the keycap emoji no longer counts as a hashtag.
* `Search Liked and Favorites grids` puts a Search button at the top of the Liked and Favorites tabs. Type a word from a caption, a creator's name or a sound and the grid shows only the loaded videos that have it, in any case, with a count of how many match. While a search is on, the grid keeps loading on its own so it looks past the first screen. Clear brings the whole grid back in its sort order. Turning the switch off (or Pause) clears the search too, so turning it back on shows the whole grid with its Search button. It starts off and sits under `Jump to a date on Liked grids` in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
* `Fold long comments` cuts a long comment down to its first 4 lines with "more" at the end, and a tap on more opens the rest right in that row. Replies and the creator's comments fold the same way. `Fold after` sets how many lines show, from 1 to 20. It starts off and sits under `Links in comments open` in Hushfeed settings > Comments.
* `Pause before the feed` puts a short countdown in front of For You the first time it opens after TikTok starts or comes back from the background. Continue lights up when the count ends, and Leave TikTok sends the app away instead. Messages, profiles and search open without it, and a trip to messages doesn't start the count over. It's in seconds (0 to 60), starts at 0 (off) and sits under `Don't start the first video` in Hushfeed settings > Screen time. Making it shorter waits a day when `Wait a day to loosen the budget` is on, like the budget's own numbers.

### Bug Fixes

* `Blur the video behind the bar` shows the video in the glass pill again on TikTok 47.7.3. The player now draws a smaller picture than the space it fills on screen, and the blur asked for a part of it that didn't exist, so every read failed and the pill stayed plain glass. LIVE previews in For You are found again too, since the LIVE player now builds its picture layer on its own (#259).
* With `See-through bottom bar` or `See-through status bar` on, a video no longer shrinks for a moment and grows back right after you swipe to it. As each video starts TikTok puts the picture back to its own size, and for a moment lays the player out a little shorter, and Hushfeed now fills the picture again for the player's real size before each frame is shown (#390).
* Saving works again behind a proxy app whose fake-IP mode answers with an IPv6 address from its own private range, like mihomo's `fdfe:dcba:9876::/64`. Hushfeed only knew the narrower fc00::/18 range, so every video and photo save stopped with "Media URL resolves to a non-public address". Any private IPv6 range a fake-IP proxy hands out counts now, and when a save is still turned down for a local address, the message names the range instead of saying nothing (#387).
* A comment row could show the translated text of the comment it held before. TikTok reuses rows as you scroll, and a row it reused for a picture or sticker comment kept listening for the old comment's translation, so a translation landing for that comment afterwards (from `Auto translate comments`, say) showed up in the wrong row until you scrolled. A row now stops listening for its old comment as soon as it gets a new one. With `Auto translate comments` on, a row could also keep the other video's comment when you opened one video's comments right after another's, because the translation request went out while TikTok was still filling the row in. It now waits until the row is done (#383).
* With `Hide unpersonalized For You videos` on, a For You batch that's nothing but fill-in now keeps just its first video instead of all of them, so far fewer unpicked videos slip through while the feed still has somewhere to go. Thanks to @yokkkoso (#391).
* A mouse wheel or touchpad scroll over the daily hold, the tap to start stop, the App lock screen, the Start page cover or the profile grid's sort hold no longer scrolls what's behind it. A hold too tall for the screen scrolls itself instead.
* On the App lock screen TalkBack goes straight to Unlock and reads "TikTok is locked" along with it. It used to stop on the title by itself first.
* With App lock on and `Open TikTok on` set to Inbox, Profile or another tab, TalkBack and Tab reach Unlock right away while TikTok opens. The start screen used to hide the lock screen from them for up to 8 seconds.
* During the daily hold, pressing the right arrow key on the last tab no longer slides TikTok over to a creator's profile, and TalkBack's scroll actions can't page it there either. Arrow keys still move between the tabs and the hold's buttons.
* `Latest first on Following` loads further ahead. TikTok sends only a few posts per read on Following and asked for more just three posts before the end, so a newer post often showed up after you'd already scrolled past older ones. With the switch on, the next read starts while about a dozen posts are still waiting below you, so more of them are sorted before you get there. With it off, Following loads the way TikTok does (#226).
* While App lock is up, a dialog, sheet or popup TikTok opens no longer shows on top of the lock screen or takes a tap. One that was already open when TikTok locked goes behind it too, and after you unlock they're back as they were.
* `Remove LIVE extras` leaves the files LIVE invitations, co-hosting, joining as a guest and battle scores run on alone now. Picking every patch used to empty the guest call library, so friends' invitations never showed up and joining a LIVE failed. The patch is down to the LIVE games script and animated gift effects, so it saves very little space now (#382, #107, #132).
* `Icon picture` in `Custom launcher icon` takes the folder Morphe Manager's picker hands back. It uses the only PNG in that folder, or the one named `icon.png` when there are several, and otherwise stops and names the PNGs it found. The hidden `._` copies a Mac leaves next to each picture on a memory card don't count, and a folder that can't be read says so instead of claiming it holds no PNG. Before, picking a folder stopped patching with "there's no file" until you typed the file name in by hand (Discussion #288).
* With `Check for already-saved videos` on, saving something you already have no longer flashes "Saving" right before Open or Save again comes up. That note now waits until the check finds it's new, for sounds, original photos and photo posts saved as a video (#356).
* A LIVE quality you pick stays picked after TikTok restarts as soon as `Offer LIVE quality in more rooms` is on. `Keep the LIVE quality after TikTok restarts` used to start off as well, so the next launch opened rooms at Auto again. It starts on now, and you can still turn it off (#353).
* With `Hide CAPTCHA popups` off, which is how it starts, a puzzle that shows while you're just browsing (in a LIVE room, say) now gets a short note naming that switch. It shows once a session, and never for a puzzle the switch would show anyway, like a sign-in check (#87).
* Hiding Report from the share sheet doesn't take `Block this creator` with it anymore. Block sits where Report would have been, in the share sheet and in the long-press menu (#367).
* With `Open TikTok on` set to Profile, Inbox, Friends or Discover, For You doesn't flash up for a second before that tab anymore. TikTok always builds Home first, so the start screen now stays up until your tab is showing (#360).
* With `Open TikTok on` set to Profile, Inbox, Friends or Discover, the phone's Back no longer drops you on For You. Back from another tab takes you to the one TikTok opens on, and Back there closes TikTok the way it closes any other app. When `Search instead of Home` or the feed lock has TikTok open on Inbox or Profile instead, Back follows that tab. Picking For You or Following keeps TikTok's own Back (#360).
* With `Let other apps play until a video starts` on, your music comes back about a quarter second after you leave a paused video for the inbox, a chat or a profile. It used to stay quiet for a second or two first (#283).
* A bio handle with a period and a date stuck to it, like @john.doe11/30/24, stays plain text now. In 0.81.0 it linked only the part before the period, which opened a different account (#247).
* With `Long-press Profile for Watch history` on, holding Profile opens Watch history again after you remove your second account. Before, the hold did nothing until TikTok rebuilt its tab bar (#341).
* Hushfeed adds less lag when a video opens from Search or Explore. The part that hides buttons on videos rebuilt its whole lookup list on every screen layout while the page opened, and now builds it once. With `Playback quality` set, each video's addresses get checked once too, instead of again in every place the player asks (#344).
* LIVE Auto tap taps the host's side of the stream now. In a battle or a room with guests it used to tap near the middle, hit the other creator's half and open their profile card, which stopped it after a second. If a tap still opens a card, the next start in that room skips that spot (#335).
* With `LIVE recording source` set to Screen, a recording keeps going after you allow it. Android's permission screen made TikTok think you were leaving the room, so TikTok shrank the LIVE into its own picture-in-picture window and the recording stopped a few seconds in.
* On some phones the screen blinked each time a video slid under the bar with `See-through bottom bar` on. The new `Stop the blink under the bar` switch under it has TikTok draw the video inside its own window instead of on a separate layer, which those phones were dropping for a frame. It starts off and takes a TikTok restart (#232).
* `See-through bottom bar` works on the Following tab too. TikTok keeps a strip the height of the bar at the bottom of that feed and paints it black, so the video there still stopped above the tabs. That strip goes clear with the switch now (#232).
* With `See-through bottom bar` on, the still picture TikTok shows while a video starts lines up with the video when TikTok has moved the video up a little. It used to sit higher than the video, with a dark strip under it (#232).
* An imported font and `Use system font` now reach TikTok's own screens, like its Settings pages, on installs patched from the split APK bundle. TikTok's fonts aren't in the bundle, so TikTok had nothing to swap and fell back to the phone's default font. Bold text stays bold (#346).
* `Hide TikTok Shop` also hides the "Find <product>" button with the shopping bag that sits above the search bar on some videos. 0.81.0 only caught a different Find bar, and the diagnostic export now counts this button on its own line (#271).
* `Remove story rings` and `Remove the LIVE ring` take the rings off on the feed, in comments and on profiles again. TikTok 47.7.2 hands each picture its story status directly and asks a different place whether someone's live, so the old hooks missed most of them. The stories trays at the top of the Inbox, Following and Friends keep their rings, because TikTok takes anyone without one out of the tray (#351).
* `AMOLED dark theme` reaches the popup that says "You'll see fewer posts like this" after Not interested, the comments' sort menu and TikTok's other toasts and small popup menus. They stayed gray before (#368).
* With `AMOLED dark theme` on, the X that closes the comments no longer sits on a gray circle. The circle takes the AMOLED color now, along with other buttons and rows on TikTok's sheets drawn in that same gray. Turning off `AMOLED dark mode` brings the gray back (#371).
* With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, the names in a LIVE's moderator settings and its muted and blocked lists read white on the dark sheet. They came out dark gray before. The "Support this LIVE" bubble over the gift button keeps its dark text on white too, where it had turned white on white (#362).
* `Remove creation tools` keeps the camera's face model and the effect editor library now, so face effects, Retouch and All effects work with it in. It still takes out the two big effects engine libraries TikTok doesn't load for any of that, about 45 MB, on the APK and on the bundle alike (#285).
* The Suggested accounts heading in the Inbox lines its title and info icon up with `Clear all` again. Hushfeed's taller Clear all button had pushed them up above it (#358).
* With `Compact comment header` on, the translate and close buttons no longer sit on top of the first comment. TikTok 47.7.2 moved them out of the header into their own row, so they stayed behind when the header went away. They're hidden along with the rest of the header now (#358).
* Profiles with their own stickers show the Stickers tab again on TikTok 47.7.3, and tapping it opens their sticker sets and video stickers instead of a "Something went wrong" page (#214).
* With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, Video quality under a LIVE's Share menu is dark all the way through. Its sheet went dark before, but the list of qualities sat on a white card with dark text, and its close X was nearly black on black (#168).
* The install steps now say to patch TikTok with Hushfeed's patches alone, since another source picked beside it can add to the memory patching needs. They also say what fit in tests with the 1 GB a 32-bit Manager can give the patcher. Simple mode's patches did, and so did every patch at once except with `AMOLED dark theme` and `Region spoof` both on, so turn on only one of them there (#339, #252).
* Patching with Simple mode's patches needs less memory. `Allow screenshots and Circle to Search` no longer rewrites the spots in TikTok that only keep the screen on or go full screen, which is about half the ones it touched. On 47.7.3 that's 1324 classes rebuilt instead of 1460, and patching now finishes with 832 MB where it used to need 896 MB (#339).
* Patching with Simple mode's patches needs less memory again. `Turn off haptics` no longer rewrites the 443 spots where TikTok gives a view a long-press action. It quiets the long-press buzz from TikTok's screens instead, while your finger is down, and text fields keep their selection buzz. On 47.7.3 that's 1057 classes rebuilt instead of 1324, and patching finishes with 768 MB (#339).
* With a color picked in `AMOLED dark theme`, a LIVE room's comment bar, its emoji picker and the boxes behind the picker's send and delete buttons take that color under `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode`. They used to stay TikTok's own dark gray, so a tinted theme showed two shades there. With the default black they look the same as before (#329).
* The build no longer pulls in a Guava or Netty release with known advisories against it. Guava moves to 33.8.0, past CVE-2026-118042, and the Netty that Android's test tools bring along moves to 4.1.139, past a critical netty-handler advisory. None of it reaches the app on your phone.
* The README's install steps name the TikTok version a release was built for once that release is out. 0.80.0 and 0.81.0 went out with the steps still pointing at the TikTok before it.
* `Disable telemetry` also stops TikTok's Orbu log upload and its whoami lookups, which were still going out on 47.7.3 (#379).
* `Hide surveys` takes the interest buttons off a video by their own view as well, for when TikTok builds them some other way. The diagnostic report now names each kind of feed component a video was given (#293).
* Blocking a LIVE host with `Block this creator` and swiping to the next room before the block went through no longer closes the room you moved to.
* TalkBack reads the sort button on a profile, Liked or sound grid as a button and says the order it's on, like "Sort this grid: Original order". It only said "Sort this grid" before. The count that shows while a sorted grid loads reads as "30 videos" now, where it was a bare number.
* On a phone set to Arabic or another right-to-left language, the button rows in What's new, the sticker sheet and the Feature Gate Lab run right to left now. The gaps inside the search box, a recent search, the status card and the notices are mirrored to match. In the Lab, a gate's title no longer runs into its value and `Apply overrides` keeps some space from its switch, whichever way the screen reads.
* On a right-to-left phone, a setting's description now sits under its name on the icon's side, and a section's heading starts on that side too. Hushfeed's text is English, so those lines used to start at the far left, across the row from the name.
* `Hide the LIVE button` now shows the restart button when you flip it, like the search and side menu switches. Turned off, the LIVE button stayed missing with nothing telling you it needed a restart.
* If you left a video cleared with `Keep Clear display across videos` on, the first video after you reopen TikTok clears too, instead of keeping its buttons. Its tabs and buttons also stay hidden while TikTok gets ready to clear it, so they don't flash up first.
* With `Hide CAPTCHA popups` on, tapping hearts in a LIVE no longer hides TikTok's check. It shows, the same as it does for a save or a gift, because a hidden check left the hearts on screen while TikTok counted none of them. When TikTok turns your taps down, Hushfeed says so once, the way it does for a video like (#380).
* The sort button and the jump buttons on profile, Liked and sound grids sit on a darker backdrop, so their words read over a white or busy thumbnail (#378).
* The hold speed bubble follows your phone's font size now, in both the pill and the round dial. With large text on, the speed used to stay small while everything else in Hushfeed grew. The whole bubble grows with it, so the padlock and the dots keep their room.
* With `Open TikTok on` set to Inbox, Profile or another tab, TalkBack can't land on the For You feed hidden under the start screen while TikTok opens.
* Restoring a settings backup, resetting settings or undoing either one now updates the feed's text size and color, the commenter names, a searched Liked or Favorites grid, the buttons on the video, feed mute, the comment search box and kept captions right away, the same as flipping those switches by hand. A grid you'd searched stayed narrowed after a restore turned `Search Liked and Favorites grids` off. If one of those can't redraw, the rest still do.
* A switch your patch options turned on now works from the first launch, including the privacy and speed switches TikTok reads before Hushfeed's settings load. Those early reads treated them as off until you'd flipped them yourself.
* `Included diagnostics` shows the choice a restored backup brought back. A saved choice it doesn't know now includes everything, where it used to export an empty log.
* When `Turn back on` can't save, it says "Couldn't save the change. Try again." instead of acting like Hushfeed came back on.
* Shared diagnostics leave out email addresses, phone numbers, account names and your proxy's address. Phone numbers written with spaces, dashes or brackets go too, and so does a nickname of several words or the name in front of your proxy's or router's address. A name with a smiley, an apostrophe or a comma in it is left out whole, and so is one written after a folder path. A time zone like +1000 next to a log's timestamp stays, since it isn't a phone number. A value that starts on the next line of a logged message goes too, along with any password or token written inside it, and a stack trace under an empty field stays readable. Details logged after a video's id, like its place in the feed, stay readable too. Text inside logged JSON, even JSON quoted inside other JSON, is now read like any other text, so a name or number tucked in there goes the same way. Version numbers like 4.12.0.1 and stack trace lines from Scala code stay readable.
* Opening a video from a sorted or searched Liked grid, or from your sorted private videos, now swipes in the grid's order, and a search plays its matches first. Those two grids have a tap handler of their own, so their video page kept TikTok's order while your posts followed the sort (#180).
* On TikTok 47.7.3 the Favorites tab gets its sort button, position rail and Search button. TikTok tucks that grid inside an extra container there, so none of them showed up, and they now sit just under the Posts and Collections row (#180).
* A background job that fails, like the media cache's start-up cleanup, now shows up in the diagnostics log. Before, nothing recorded it.
* On the light theme, the shine that runs across the Hushfeed settings title no longer washes the letters out. It's softer there now, so the title stays readable while it passes.
* TalkBack doesn't stop on the screen that holds the feed as a whole anymore. It used to read everything on it a second time and offer to activate it, which did nothing. The title, the countdown and both buttons are still read one by one.
* Tab on a keyboard or d-pad can't wander into the feed behind the daily hold anymore. It used to move from the hold into the video and the like and comment buttons underneath. Now it goes between the hold's buttons and the tabs along the bottom, which TalkBack can reach again too.
* With the feed lock on, coming back to TikTok no longer puts the "Tap to start the feed" layer on top of the lock screen. It took the first tap there, which could start a video behind the lock.
* With App lock up, Tab goes straight to Unlock. It used to stop on the black screen first, and TalkBack offered to press that screen, which did nothing. Anything TikTok opens while it's locked stays behind the lock screen too.

patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Makes TikTok's dark mode backgrounds pure black, or a dark color you pick in this patch's options. Black lets OLED screens switch those pixels off. Light mode doesn't change. The AMOLED dark mode switch in Hushfeed settings > App starts on, and turning it off brings TikTok's own dark grays back.

options.description: Pick a color, or type a solid color code like #000000. Black lets OLED screens turn those pixels off completely.

patches.name: Accent color
patches.description: Swaps the red of TikTok's main buttons and red text for blue, green, purple, orange, teal or a color code you type in this patch's options, or for the color of the phone's wallpaper theme on Android 12 and up. Unread dots and counts change with it. Warnings stay red, and so can icons with the red drawn in. The feed's like heart and save bookmark can take colors of their own. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it undoes it.

options.description: Pick a preset, or type a solid color code like #2D7FF9. TikTok original leaves the red as it is. TikTok's lighter and darker reds follow the color you pick.
The heart on a video you liked, in the feed and in its tap animation. TikTok original leaves it red. It works in light, dark and AMOLED alike, with or without a new accent.
The bookmark on a video you saved to Favorites, in the feed and in its animation. TikTok original leaves it yellow.

On Android 12 and up, buttons and red text take the color of the phone's wallpaper theme and change when the wallpaper does, and the color above is not used. Android 11 and older keep TikTok's red. The soft see-through reds stay as they are.

patches.name: Account cleanup
patches.description: Adds Remove all reposts, Remove all likes and Clear Favorites to Hushfeed settings > Privacy. Each one takes items off your account one at a time through TikTok's own requests, with a pause between them, and stops on the first error.

patches.name: Advanced downloads
patches.description: Adds more ways to save: pick the video quality, save full-size photos, the sound on its own or a photo post as one video, hold a profile picture or story to save it, save a story or a video's cover from the share sheet, put a save button on the video, and pick videos on a profile grid to save in one run. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Allow Duet and Stitch
patches.description: Shows the Duet and Stitch buttons on videos whose creator turned them off, so you can still make one, and Add to Story in the share sheet and on stories when the creator turned off content reuse. TikTok may still refuse some videos or the upload. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.

patches.name: Allow screenshots and Circle to Search
patches.description: Lets screenshots, screen recordings and Circle to Search work on TikTok screens that would otherwise come out black. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches.name: Always show publish date
patches.description: Shows the date a video was posted next to the creator's name, so you can tell how old it is. It can also show the exact time, dates and lengths on profile grids, sort the videos a grid has loaded, start your Liked grid at a year or month you pick, or add a drag handle and jump buttons to long grids. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Always upload in HD
patches.description: Posts every video you upload in HD, as if you'd turned on TikTok's own HD upload setting each time. Videos TikTok doesn't count as high quality post as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: App lock
patches.description: Asks for your fingerprint, face or PIN before TikTok opens, and again when you come back after a time you pick, so nobody else can open it on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Automatic video advance
patches.description: Moves on to the next video by itself when one ends, so you can watch hands-free. It can also turn on TikTok's auto scroll in search results. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Block P2P video relay
patches.description: Removes the files TikTok uses to pass videos on to other viewers through your phone's internet connection. The app gets about 4.5 MB smaller. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it brings them back.

patches.name: Block author button
patches.description: Adds buttons on videos to block the creator, hide them only on your phone, or block the sound, so you can get rid of what you don't want in one tap. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Block contact list access
patches.description: Gives TikTok an empty contact list when it tries to read your phone's contacts, so it can't use them to suggest friends. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Block installed app scanning
patches.description: Gives TikTok an empty list when it asks which apps are on your phone, so it learns less about you. Opening another app from TikTok still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Block popups
patches.description: Lets you stop TikTok's popups, like friend suggestions and offers. Each one joins a checklist after it first appears, and once ticked it won't come back. Sign-in, age and verification screens are never blocked. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Block suggested video notifications
patches.description: Stops TikTok's "Videos you might like" notifications about popular videos it picked for you. Messages, comments, likes and posts from people you follow still come through. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches.name: Camera and microphone indicator
patches.description: Shows a small mark in the top corner while TikTok is using the camera or microphone, so you always know when it is. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Change app name
patches.description: Shows a name you choose under the app icon, so the patched TikTok is easy to tell apart from another copy. Type the name in this patch's options. Inside the app it still says TikTok.

options.description: The name shown under the app icon, up to 50 characters.

patches.name: Comment publish diagnostics
patches.description: Adds a note to Hushfeed's diagnostic report about how far a comment got when it fails to post, which helps track down comments that vanish without an error. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Comment send fix
patches.description: Fixes comments that TikTok sometimes drops without any message, so the comment you send actually posts. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Comment sort controls
patches.description: Shows TikTok's full comment sort menu on every video, with hot, newest, media and creator options, even when your account only got a cut-down version. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches.name: Comment tools
patches.description: Hides comments with words you pick or from accounts you pick, and adds a search box for a video's comments. It can also make links tappable and show poll results before you vote. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches.name: Confirm feed interactions
patches.description: Asks for a second tap before Follow, a like, or a quick repost goes through, so a stray tap doesn't count. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Copy bio and IDs
patches.description: Lets you long-press a bio to copy it, makes the @names in a bio open those profiles on a tap, and adds share sheet buttons that copy a display name, username, user ID or video ID. On a profile card inside a LIVE room, long-press the bio or the name to copy it, long-press the username for the user ID, or tap the copy mark by the username. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Copy comments without username
patches.description: When you copy a comment, you get just its text, without the username in front. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches.name: Create stickers
patches.description: Adds a Create button to the Saved page of the comment sticker panel. Pick a photo and it turns into one of your saved stickers. Make sticker in a video's share sheet opens TikTok's sticker editor for any video, or uses its cover when the editor can't open. Profiles that have stickers keep their Stickers tab, and it opens their sticker sets. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Custom launcher icon
patches.description: Gives TikTok's home screen icon a themed version that takes your wallpaper's color on Android 13 and up. The options can also make it black, plain, Material You, any background color or your own picture, and put Hushfeed's H in the status bar. Only patching again without it puts the old icons back.

options.description: TikTok colors keeps the icon as it is. Black background puts TikTok's note on pure black, and the two plain styles draw only the note in one color. Material You colors the note and its background from your wallpaper on Android 12 and up, light or dark with the system, even with themed icons off, and is white on black before that. Every style gets the themed icon.
A color like #1E88E5 to put behind the note, or behind your picture, instead of the style's own. Leave it empty to keep the style's.

Where to find a square PNG picture of your own, 432 to 1024 pixels on each side, to use instead of TikTok's note. Home screens trim icons to their own shape, so keep what matters in the middle two thirds. With a picture, the style only sets the color behind it and there's no themed icon. A folder works too when the picture is the only PNG in it or is named icon.png. Leave it empty to keep the note.
The small icon TikTok's notifications show in the status bar. TikTok's note keeps it as it is. Hushfeed's H swaps it for a sharp H on every screen.

patches.name: Custom offline videos limit
patches.description: Lets you pick how many videos TikTok saves for watching offline, from 1 to 10,000, and keep them until you delete them. Handy when you're often without internet. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Device privacy guard
patches.description: Stops TikTok reading what you copied and gives it a blank advertising ID. Can also hide a VPN connection and root status with details about root tools, and give TikTok a new device identity. Each switch starts off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy. Changing Hide root needs a restart.

patches.name: Diagnostic tools
patches.description: Adds logs and reports you can save or share when something goes wrong, so a problem is easier to report and fix. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.

patches.name: Disable login requirement
patches.description: Stops TikTok from forcing you to sign in before you can keep browsing. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Disable screen capture detection
patches.description: Stops TikTok from noticing and reacting when you take a screenshot or record the screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Stops TikTok sending usage statistics and crash reports to TikTok and the tracking services it uses, so less of what you do in the app leaves your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable the long press quick share
patches.description: Stops a long press on Share from opening TikTok's quick share, so you don't send a video by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Disable the long press repost
patches.description: Stops a long press on Like from opening TikTok's repost option, so you don't repost by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Double-tap controls
patches.description: Lets a double tap on a video do nothing, open its comments, copy the link, save the sound or the frame on screen, speed the video up, or set a sleep timer instead of liking it, so you don't like videos by accident. Each corner of the video can get its own action too. Starts off. Pick an action in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Downloads
patches.description: Saves videos and photos without TikTok's watermark, even when the creator turned downloads off. You can also choose the folders and file names. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Drop the animated image cache
patches.description: Lets you make TikTok decode animated stickers and GIFs one frame at a time as they play, instead of a few frames ahead, so they use a little less memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Enable voice comments
patches.description: Lets you turn on TikTok's voice comments, so you can record and post a spoken comment, for accounts that don't have them yet. It hasn't been tried on a real account, so it may not work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches.name: Expand activity list
patches.description: Shows the whole Activity and New followers lists in the Inbox, so you don't have to tap View all. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches.name: Feature Gate Lab
patches.description: Adds an advanced page that lists the hidden settings TikTok uses to test features and lets you change them. It's for people who like to experiment. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.

patches.name: Feature Gate Recorder
patches.description: Records which hidden TikTok settings the app reads while you use it, and which ones changed. It's a research tool and changes nothing in TikTok. Start a recording in Hushfeed settings > Diagnostics.

patches.name: Feed filter
patches.description: Hides ads in the feed, and lets you hide other things you don't want to see, like LIVEs, Shop posts, AI videos or videos with words, creators or sounds you pick. Hiding ads is on by default. Everything else starts off in Hushfeed settings > Feed filter.

patches.name: Feed tab navigation
patches.description: Lets you hide feed and bottom tabs you don't use, put Discover in the bottom bar and Friends in the top tabs, rename the bottom tabs, pick the bottom bar's icons and height, choose the tab TikTok opens on, stop For You reloading when you tap Home and hold Profile to open your Watch history. Starts off, except holding Home to open Hushfeed settings. Find it in Hushfeed settings > Feed tabs.

patches.name: Feed text sizes
patches.description: Lets you make video descriptions, creator names and post dates bigger or smaller, or give them a color and a backdrop, so they're easier to read. Starts off. Pick them in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Fit the video to the screen
patches.description: Shows the whole video instead of cutting off its sides on folding phones, squarer screens and split screen, and fits photo slideshows whole on squarer screens. A second switch does the opposite and fills the screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Fix Google login
patches.description: Makes Sign in with Google work in the patched app, where it would otherwise fail. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Fix Spotify login
patches.description: Makes Add to Spotify work in the patched app. The Spotify app turns down a patched TikTok, so you sign in on Spotify's own page instead. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Foldable split comment view
patches.description: On a folding phone or tablet, shows comments beside the video instead of over it when the screen is wide enough. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Follow diagnostics
patches.description: Tells you when TikTok quietly turned down a follow, and why, since the app shows it as if it worked. With diagnostic logging on, the details go in the report too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Freeze TikTok's experiments
patches.description: Lets you keep the settings TikTok's servers sent it so far. TikTok tests new layouts and features on people by sending new ones all the time, and with this on it ignores them. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Ghost mode
patches.description: Stops TikTok telling people you viewed their story or profile, or that you're typing. What TikTok already recorded stays. Each of the three has its own switch under it, and a separate one hides your online status. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Hide CAPTCHA popups
patches.description: Skips the puzzle TikTok shows while you're just browsing. A puzzle right after you like, follow, comment or repost still shows, and so do sign-in, SMS and two-step checks. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, then restart TikTok.

patches.name: Hide Play Store update offer
patches.description: Stops the Play Store offering to swap the patched TikTok for the store version. The catch: a build with a lower version number won't install over it, and uninstalling to go back can erase TikTok's data on your phone.

patches.name: Hide already seen videos
patches.description: Remembers the videos you've watched and hides them when the feed sends them again, so you only see new ones. It can also keep a watch history you can search and reopen videos from. Both stay on your phone. Starts off. Turn them on in Hushfeed settings > Feed filter.

patches.name: Hide comment popup ads
patches.description: Stops the brand animation that pops up over the comments when someone types a word or emoji an advertiser paid for. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches.name: Hide comment typing suggestions
patches.description: Hides the emoji and sticker suggestions that pop up above the comment box while you type. The emoji and sticker buttons still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches.name: Hide feed LIVE button
patches.description: Removes the LIVE button and the side menu button from the top left of the feed, for a cleaner screen, and can stop a right swipe on For You from opening the side menu. Each has its own switch, and all start off. Turn them on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Hide feed follow button
patches.description: Removes the + follow button under creators' pictures on the feed, so you don't follow someone by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Hide feed save button
patches.description: Removes the save button from the right side of the feed, for a cleaner screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Hide feed search button
patches.description: Removes the search button from the top right of the feed and the one over the video while comments are open. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Hide floating promotions
patches.description: Hides the floating promotion badges, coins and timers on the feed, and can hide the rewards button on your profile. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, and App for the rewards button.

patches.name: Hide inbox items
patches.description: Lets you hide Inbox rows you don't use, like message requests, TikTok Shop, the stories row and the On this day memory in it, plus call buttons and suggested replies in chats. Each has its own switch. Also offers search in loaded Activity notifications and TikTok's Main, Requests, Unread and Starred tabs on any account, a way to rebuild message search and room to pin more than 5 chats. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches.name: Hide inbox stories
patches.description: Hides the row of stories at the top of the Inbox. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches.name: Hide profile shortcuts
patches.description: Hides the shortcuts you pick from the row under a profile's bio, like TikTok Studio or Your orders, and the profile tabs you pick, like Reposts or Liked videos. It can hide the Thoughts bubble, and Balance and the TikTok Minis icons in your profile's menu. It can also turn Thoughts on for accounts TikTok left out. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches.name: Hide read receipts
patches.description: Stops TikTok telling people you've read their messages. Your own unread badges still clear as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches.name: Hide search suggestions
patches.description: Hides the searches TikTok suggests before you type, and can hide the search rewards banner. Your own search history stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Hide suggested accounts
patches.description: Hides TikTok's People you may like suggestions in the Inbox, on profiles, on the Friends tab and in the feed. It uses the same switch as Hide inbox items. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches.name: Hide the launcher shortcuts
patches.description: Empties the menu that pops up when you press and hold TikTok's icon on your home screen. Tapping the icon still opens the app. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Hide the risk control CAPTCHA
patches.description: Lets Hide CAPTCHA popups also skip the puzzle TikTok's account safety check raises while you're just browsing. SMS and two-step checks always show. It sits on TikTok's account checks, which is why it isn't picked for you.

patches.name: Hide video overlays
patches.description: Lets you hide clutter over videos, like the caption, the music line, buttons on the right, surveys and location labels, so you see more of the video. It can also make the music disc spin again or keep it still. Each has its own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock
patches.description: Turns on TikTok's own gesture where you hold a video, slide down and let go to keep it playing fast without holding. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: In-app browser privacy guard
patches.description: Stops websites you open in TikTok's built-in browser from reaching into the TikTok app. TikTok's own pages, like Watch history and checkout, keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Keep a streak going
patches.description: Sends a daily message you choose to people you pick, at a time you set, so your message streaks keep going on days you don't open TikTok. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches.name: Keep playing in the background
patches.description: Keeps the video playing when you leave TikTok or turn the screen off, with a notification to pause it. It can also start the video over when it ends. Handy for music and talks. If you only want it on some videos, a second switch adds TikTok's own row to the long-press menu. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback, then restart TikTok.

patches.name: Keep pulled sounds
patches.description: Plays the sound on videos TikTok muted for copyright or because of where you live. TikTok may still say the sound isn't available. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Keep recent stickers
patches.description: Adds Recently used above Saved in the comment sticker panel, with the last stickers you sent, and keeps it when you close and reopen the app. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Keep the Favorites tab
patches.description: Keeps the Favorites tab and your saved videos on your profile when TikTok tries out a version of the app that hides them, and makes the collections popup you get by holding the Favorites button dark when TikTok is. Both are on by default. Turn them off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Keep the app language
patches.description: Lets you keep the language you picked in TikTok's own settings. When TikTok starts and decides the phone's language changed, it drops that pick and follows the phone, which can leave it in the wrong language after a reboot. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Keep the next videos in full screen
patches.description: From most pages, TikTok's full screen view opens with only the video you were on, so there's nothing to swipe to and it can't move on by itself. This brings the videos after it along. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Keep the screen's brightness in the camera
patches.description: Stops TikTok from turning your screen brighter while you film, edit or post a video. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Keep the screen's refresh rate
patches.description: Stops TikTok slowing your screen down to the video's frame rate, so scrolling stays smooth on 90 or 120 Hz phones. TikTok doesn't ask on every phone, and where it doesn't, this changes nothing. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Keep unsent messages
patches.description: Keeps a message in your chat when the other person unsends it, instead of removing it, and can mark it as unsent. A button removes the kept messages. Messages you unsend yourself are still removed. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches.name: LIVE controls
patches.description: Stops a LIVE in the feed from opening by itself after a countdown. It can show a LIVE's exact viewer count instead of a rounded one, offer a quality choice and clear screen in more LIVE rooms, and keep your quality pick after TikTok restarts. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback. It also keeps a LIVE in the feed from showing the Service+ row of the LIVE before it (or hides that row altogether), and can add a Record button to a LIVE room that saves what you watch from when you tap it.

patches.name: Lift text length limits
patches.description: Lets you write longer comments, repost notes and bios than the app normally allows. TikTok can still refuse one that's too long. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches.name: Limit background traffic
patches.description: Lets you stop TikTok loading upcoming videos ahead of time, which uses less data in the background, but videos may take a moment longer to start. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

options.description: With this on, the Limit background traffic switch in Hushfeed settings also stops TikTok setting up notifications, so you won't get any, messages included. Turn the switch off or pause Hushfeed to get them back.

patches.name: Load all saved stickers
patches.description: Loads every sticker you saved in one go when you open the sticker panel, instead of the first 100. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Location access governor
patches.description: Gives TikTok no location when it asks, so it can't see where you are from your phone's location services. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Long-press controls
patches.description: Lets a long press on a video like it, open the comments, copy the link, save the sound or the frame on screen, or set a sleep timer, and can give a creator's videos For You's full long-press menu. Starts off. Pick an action in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Look like the store app
patches.description: Makes the patched app answer TikTok's checks as if it came from the Play Store, which can help when follows or likes undo themselves. TikTok has other checks, so it may not be enough. On once picked. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Mute feed videos
patches.description: Mutes feed videos without changing your phone's volume, so music from another app keeps playing. You can also add a mute button on videos, or keep the sound and let other apps play until a video starts and after you leave it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Network proxy
patches.description: Sends TikTok's feed, search and comments through a proxy server you set up. Videos and LIVEs still load directly, and so do Hushfeed's own saves and short-link lookups. HTTP and SOCKS5 both work, with or without a password. Other apps aren't affected. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region, then restart TikTok.

patches.name: Network request report
patches.description: Counts the requests TikTok sends to its servers and adds the totals to the diagnostic report. It changes nothing in TikTok, but it has no switch and most people don't need it.

patches.name: Not interested button
patches.description: Adds a button on videos that tells TikTok you're not interested in one tap, so it can show you fewer like it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Notification controls
patches.description: Lets you turn off new follower notifications and streak reminders, which TikTok has no switch for, or turn off TikTok's notifications altogether. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches.name: Open external links directly
patches.description: Opens website links from profiles and stories in your phone's own browser instead of TikTok's built-in one. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Open the comments at full height
patches.description: Opens the comment sheet at the full height of the screen instead of part way up. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches.name: Picture-in-picture
patches.description: Keeps the video playing in a small window when you leave TikTok, so you can keep watching while you use other apps. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Play SDR instead of HDR
patches.description: Plays the normal version of HDR videos, so your screen doesn't suddenly jump to full brightness. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Playback quality
patches.description: Lets you choose the video quality, like highest, lowest or 720p, and set a lower quality for mobile data to use less data. Starts off. Pick a quality in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Playback speed
patches.description: Remembers the speed you picked for the next video, and lets you set a default speed, add speeds up to 3x to the menu and choose the speed for press and hold. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Prefer H.264 playback
patches.description: Plays videos in an older format your phone decodes more easily, which can help older phones play smoothly and run cooler. Videos without it play as before. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Profile background
patches.description: Opens TikTok's own profile background editor in Edit profile on accounts TikTok hasn't offered it to yet, and shows the backgrounds other profiles have set. TikTok's servers may still refuse to save one for such an account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Region spoof
patches.description: Makes TikTok's region and time zone match the country you set for SIM spoof. It changes every region check, sign-in included, and its store region switch is experimental, so it isn't picked for you. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region.

patches.name: Remember clear display
patches.description: Keeps clear display, TikTok's mode that hides the buttons over a video, on as you swipe to the next video (`Keep Clear display across videos` turns that part off). It can also turn on by itself after a delay you pick, which starts off in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen. When clear display ends, the Following stories bubble TikTok hid comes back too.

patches.name: Remove LIVE extras
patches.description: Removes the script for games inside LIVEs and turns off animated gift effects. It saves very little space. The catch: LIVE games and animated gifts may stop working. Co-hosting, joining a LIVE as a guest, invitations and battle scores aren't touched.

patches.name: Remove avatar rings
patches.description: Takes the story and LIVE rings off profile pictures, so tapping a picture opens the profile instead of a story or LIVE. It can also open a LIVE creator's Story from their profile picture or their chat in the Inbox. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Remove content credential and card scanner assets
patches.description: Removes TikTok's payment card scanner and content credential files, saving about 11 MB of storage. Anything in TikTok that needs them may stop working. Only patching again without it brings them back.

patches.name: Remove creation tools
patches.description: Removes two effects engine libraries TikTok doesn't load for the camera, effects, Retouch or the video editor, saving about 45 MB. Those all keep working. If a creation tool ever closes TikTok, repatch without this one.

patches.name: Remove unused language packs
patches.description: Removes the app languages you don't list in this patch's options, saving up to about 26 MB of storage. English is always kept. With no list it keeps them all. Only patching again brings removed ones back.

options.description: The languages to keep, as short codes separated by commas, like en, es, pt, fr or de. Type all to keep every language. English is always kept.

patches.name: Remove voice tools
patches.description: Removes TikTok's speech recognition files, saving about 16 MB of storage. The catch: voice search, naming a song by listening, talking to TikTok's AI assistant and TikTok's music check on videos you post all stop working. Only patching again without it brings them back.

patches.name: Report a newer phone to effects
patches.description: Tells TikTok's effects server you have a newer phone, so effects it turns down on older phones get another chance. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Repost diagnostics
patches.description: With diagnostic logging on, notes when you repost a video and what TikTok answered, to help track down reposts that don't stick. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Resource and battery governor
patches.description: Stops TikTok reading your phone's motion sensors, which it can use to identify your phone, and stops a background speed test that can use a lot of memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Resume videos after scrolling
patches.description: When you scroll back to a video, it picks up where you left off instead of starting over. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Run beside the store app
patches.description: Lets a renamed copy of TikTok, made with Morphe's Clone app patch, sign in while the regular TikTok stays installed. Pick it together with Clone app. Google and Facebook sign-in won't work in the copy, so use email or phone.

patches.name: SIM spoof
patches.description: Makes TikTok see the SIM country and carrier you choose. It may not change your region, since TikTok also goes by your internet connection and account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Removes the tracking codes from TikTok links you share, so the link carries less about you. It can also swap tiktok.com for another site. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Settings
patches.description: Adds the Hushfeed settings page to TikTok, at the top of Settings and privacy. Pressing and holding For You at the top of the feed opens it too. That's where you turn Hushfeed's features on and off. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Share sheet tools
patches.description: Lets you hide people, apps and buttons you don't use from the share sheet, add apps you do use, and copy a video's link with one press on Share. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.

patches.name: Show LIVE search
patches.description: Adds TikTok's search button inside the LIVE section where TikTok supports it, so you can look for LIVEs. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Show author region
patches.description: Shows the country a video was posted from next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Show commenter handle and region
patches.description: Shows a commenter's @username in place of their display name and the country their account is set to after the comment's time. It can also give each commenter's name a color of its own. Each starts off. Turn them on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches.name: Show engagement rate
patches.description: Shows how many people liked, commented on, shared or saved a video compared with how many watched it, next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Show exact counts
patches.description: Shows likes, comments and other counts as full numbers, like 1,234,567 instead of 1.2M. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Show follow status
patches.description: Shows on a profile whether that person follows you back, and marks accounts in your follow lists that don't. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App. A separate switch adds the month an account was made. Optional local counts and appearance controls apply to your own profile.

patches.name: Show the progress bar
patches.description: Shows the progress bar on videos where TikTok hides it, so you can see how long a video is and skip around. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback, where you can also show the time beside the bar or give it a bigger handle. Seek bars for video stories and sound previews are there too.

patches.name: Show the progress bar thumbnail
patches.description: Shows a small preview picture while you drag the progress bar, so you can find the part you want. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Skip content warnings
patches.description: Plays videos without the warning screen you'd have to tap through first, and can hide the Check sources and Check your sources banners. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Skip first-launch setup
patches.description: Skips TikTok's setup screens on a fresh install, like the interest picker and the swipe tutorial. Sign-in and age screens still show. Its switch is on once picked, since setup runs before you can reach settings. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Skip passkey sign-in
patches.description: Lets you sign in another way, like your password or a code by email or text, when TikTok wants a passkey. Password managers won't hand a passkey to a patched app, so that step can't finish here. With the switch on, TikTok treats your phone as one without passkeys. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Skip the splash ad
patches.description: Lets you stop the full-screen ad TikTok can show while it starts up. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Skip update checks
patches.description: Lets you stop two background tasks TikTok uses to check for updates, one of them when your phone starts. Some in-app update prompts may stop. Play Store updates still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Stay on the video in full screen
patches.description: When a video ends in TikTok's full screen view, it stays on that video instead of moving to the next one. Swiping still moves on. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Stop on-device AI profiling
patches.description: Lets you stop TikTok's built-in AI engine from starting, so it doesn't get a copy of everything TikTok logs about your use. TikTok works as if the engine weren't there. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Stop recording watch history
patches.description: Stops TikTok adding the videos you watch to your Watch history. The catch: your views stop counting, and For You learns less about what you like. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Stop saving search history
patches.description: Stops TikTok saving your new searches on your phone. Older searches stay until you delete them, and TikTok's servers may keep their own record. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Stop search autoplay
patches.description: Stops videos in search results from playing by themselves. Each one shows its cover until you open it, so searching stays quiet. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Stop video looping
patches.description: Stops a video at its end instead of playing it again. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Story controls
patches.description: Lets a story replay when it ends instead of moving on, and keeps a photo story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches.name: Subtitle tools
patches.description: Lets you make captions bigger, change their background and keep them in clear display, bring back TikTok's captions switch where it's missing, and save subtitle files with downloaded videos. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, and Downloads for subtitle files.

patches.name: Swipe-left controls
patches.description: Lets a left swipe on a video open its comments or do nothing, instead of opening the creator's profile. Starts off. Pick an action in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches.name: Translate comments
patches.description: Translates comments as they load, using TikTok's own translator, so you don't have to tap Translate on each one. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments, where more rows list languages TikTok's automatic translation should leave alone, keep videos in the language they were made in, pick the language translations come out in, and add TikTok's translate button beside the comment count.

patches.name: Trust user certificates
patches.description: Lets TikTok trust security certificates you install yourself, so a tool like mitmproxy can show what the app sends. The risk: anyone who gets a certificate onto your phone can read TikTok's traffic too. Use it only on a test phone.

patches.name: Turn off haptics
patches.description: Stops the little vibrations TikTok makes when you tap or hold things. Your keyboard and your phone's own vibrations stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Turn off screen transitions
patches.description: Opens and closes TikTok's screens without the sliding animation, so moving around feels quicker. Swipes still follow your finger. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Use non-personalized search
patches.description: Shows search results that aren't tailored to your account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches.name: Use system font
patches.description: Shows TikTok's text in your phone's own font or in a .ttf or .otf font file you import, instead of TikTok's, and can use your phone's emoji too. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.
